endpoints.description: Each entry point of the interface the pull request adds, removes, changes or deprecates. Breaking ones first.

consumers.description: Callers of a changed entry point in this repository: an API client module, the app's calls, another service, a CLI's tests. Cite them when this pull request changes them.

label.description: The caller, as code names it: a function, module or file.

updated.description: true when this pull request changes it for the new interface; false when it still calls the old one and needs to change; null when unknown.

docs.description: The interface's documentation (an API reference, OpenAPI, a README section); null when it has none.

updated.description: true when this pull request updates it; false when it describes the old interface; null when unknown.

related.description: Written by the host, never by a fill: the review's risks and evidence whose code this tile cites.

hunk.description: A hunk of the diff, optionally narrowed to lines of the new file inside it.

lines.description: [first, last] line of the new file, inside the hunk's new range.

field.description: The field, parameter, flag or argument, as the wire or the call names it (nested fields as a.b).

change.description: unchanged: a field of a changed entry point the pull request leaves as it is, listed for context with before equal to after.

before.description: Its type or meaning before; null for an added field.

after.description: Its type or meaning after; null for a removed field.

required.description: Whether a caller must send it (request) or can rely on it (response); null when unknown.

surface.description: http: a route; rpc: a gRPC or JSON-RPC method; graphql: a query, mutation or type; tool: an agent or MCP tool; cli: a command or flag; library: an exported symbol of a published package other repositories import; event: a webhook, message or event payload; schema: a published JSON Schema, OpenAPI or proto document.

method.description: The HTTP method of a route (ANY when it accepts every method); null for every other surface.

name.description: The path with its parameters, the tool or method name, the command, the symbol or the schema's ID, as callers write it.

auth.description: Who may call it, when the code says: "session cookie", "bearer token", "public"; null when unchanged and unknown.

request.description: Request fields, parameters, flags or arguments: every one of an added entry point; the changed ones of another, and a few unchanged ones beside them, never more than the changed ones.

response.description: Response or result fields: every one of an added entry point; the changed ones of another, and a few unchanged ones beside them, never more than the changed ones.

errors.description: Status codes, error codes or exit codes added, removed or changed.

breaking.description: true when an existing caller can break: removed, renamed, a required input added, a field removed or retyped, auth tightened, a status or error code changed.

breaking_reason.description: Which existing callers break and how, in one sentence; null when not breaking.

cites.description: The hunks that show it: the registration or definition first, then the handler and types.
